description: This file defines classes for API key authentication methods (query, header, cookie) using FastAPI and Starlette, including error handling and dependency injection.

classes.name: APIKeyBase
classes.description: Base class for API key authentication, handling common logic and error responses.

classes.name: APIKeyQuery
classes.description: API key authentication via query parameter.

classes.name: APIKeyHeader
classes.description: API key authentication via request header.

methods.name: make_not_authenticated_error
methods.description: Creates an HTTP 401 Unauthorized exception with WWW-Authenticate header.

methods.name: check_api_key
methods.description: Validates the provided API key, raises error if invalid and auto_error is True.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for each class, setting up parameters for API key extraction.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves API key from request (query, header, or cookie) and validates it.
